kinds.d: Tapered, coarse-threaded screw for fixing into timber and boards.
Corrosion-resistant screw made to fix decking boards to joists.
Fine- or coarse-threaded bugle-head screw for fixing plasterboard to studs.
Hardened screw that cuts its own thread into a drilled hole in masonry or concrete.
Heavy hexagon-head wood screw driven with a spanner for structural timber fixings.
Sheet-metal screw that forms its own thread, with or without a drill point.
Parallel-threaded screw for a tapped hole or a nut.

notes: Trimmed to the brief's market brands (SPAX, Forgefix, TimCo, Fischer, Rawlplug): dropped retailer-own-brand models Spectre Advanced Double Countersunk (wood screw), Deck-Tite Composite Plus (decking) and Ulti-Mate II drywall screw; dropped the Forgefast/Wirox ranges repeated on Decking screw (kept once on Wood screw). Self-tapping screw had no old source and keeps a blank s. No kinds dropped.
